summary: COA (Certificate of Analysis) feature testing complete. Backend: 12/12 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All COA features working correctly including badges, viewer, and admin management.
passed_tests: ✅ Backend: GET /api/strains/{id}/coa returns PDF for strain with COA (200)
✅ Backend: GET /api/strains/{id}/coa requires user authentication (401)
✅ Backend: GET /api/strains/{id}/coa returns 404 for strain without COA
✅ Backend: GET /api/strains/{id}/coa returns 404 for non-existent strain
✅ Backend: PUT /api/strains/{id}/coa requires admin authentication (401)
✅ Backend: PUT /api/strains/{id}/coa successfully uploads COA PDF
✅ Backend: PUT /api/strains/{id}/coa rejects non-PDF files (400)
✅ Backend: PUT /api/strains/{id}/coa returns 404 for non-existent strain
✅ Backend: DELETE /api/strains/{id}/coa requires admin authentication (401)
✅ Backend: DELETE /api/strains/{id}/coa returns 404 for non-existent strain
✅ Backend: Strain list includes coa_url field (Jealousy has COA)
✅ Backend: Full COA workflow (upload -> view -> delete) works correctly
✅ Frontend: Strain cards show green 'COA' badge when coa_url is present
✅ Frontend: Strain detail modal shows 'View Certificate of Analysis' button for strains with COA
✅ Frontend: Strain detail modal does NOT show COA button for strains without COA (Animal Mints)
✅ Frontend: COA viewer opens as fullscreen overlay with PDF iframe
✅ Frontend: COA viewer has close button that works correctly
✅ Frontend: Admin Images tab shows 'COA Live' indicator for strains with COA (Jealousy, AIS)
✅ Frontend: Admin Images tab shows 'Upload COA' button for strains without COA
✅ Frontend: Admin Images tab shows 'Remove' button for strains with COA
